priorityList: Cast Arcane Barrage when Arcane Soul is active.
Spend any Clearcasting stacks on Arcane Missiles when Arcane Surge is about to end, so you have no Clearcasting stacks left when Arcane Soul procs.
Cast Arcane Blast as your filler.
Cast Arcane Barrage if you do not have enough mana for Arcane Blast.
Use any potions, racials or other items that buff your damage/stats in such a way so that they last throughout Touch.
When there are around 5 seconds left of Arcane Surge, cast Arcane Barrage into Touch to ensure Touch is active when Arcane Soul procs.
Cast Touch when it is ready, approximately 45 seconds after the previous use, once in-between Arcane Surge uses.
